test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
'P % Q' means 'P is the brother of Q'

'P + Q' means 'P is the daughter of Q'.

'P = Q' means 'P is the son of Q'.

'P # Q' means 'P is the wife of Q'.

If L % M + N # R = S, how is L related to S?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 %
 +
 =
 #
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Daughter
 Son
 Wife
 
 

 

Given: L % M + N # R = S

It means: L is brother of M,M is daughter of N, N is wife of R, R is son of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8e3795291ebc4da42a8968aea09737f4837a4bbc7573770c0214707751312cf.png] 

So, L is the 'Son's son' of S.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
